og_description: From the safety of Heaven Star City to the lawless outpost of Jade Emerald Island. Han Li’s new arc begins with a shopping trip and a cold warning.

lore_anchors.definition: A single-use talisman that protects a cultivator during long-distance teleportation. Unlike the Great Teleportation Token, it has a range limit and can only be used once.
The third major cultivation stage in the xianxia system, where a cultivator condenses their qi into a solid golden core in their dantian. This is a huge leap in power and lifespan.
The condensed energy core of a demonic beast, analogous to a human cultivator’s golden core. It is the prime target for hunters, used in alchemy and artifact refining.
A Beast Island in the Starfall Sea’s outer reaches, controlled by no single sect. It is a lawless frontier where rogue cultivators gather to hunt demonic beasts.
The main teleportation hub in Heaven Star City, a white marble hall containing dozens of arrays connecting to islands across the Starfall Sea.
The premier auction house in Heaven Star City. Items sold there are marked up in price by at least 50%, making it a venue for only the wealthiest of cultivators.
